findings.detail: spawn-fanout.md Step 5.1's documented parse `uptime | awk -F'load average' ... -F',' ...` splits on the comma that is the DECIMAL SEPARATOR under this host's LANG=fr_FR.UTF-8, yielding 3 from a true load of 3.69. LOAD_1MIN is the sole determinant of DEGRADED once headroom passes; both the truncated and the true value sit far below the 24 threshold (2 x 12 cores) so the verdict was unaffected AGAIN this tick, but the failure mode is fail-OPEN toward max_parallel=4.
findings.verified_fix: uptime | awk -F'load averages?:' '{print $2}' | awk '{v=$1; gsub(",",".",v); print v}'  — handles macOS plural 'load averages:' and comma-decimal in one pass.
findings.do_not: Do NOT pin LC_ALL=C as the fix — that is what produces the concatenation garbage this parse then truncates.
